settings.title: Keep it dry
settings.text: If it gets wet, let it dry slowly, away from heat.

settings.title: Feed it
settings.text: Rub in a little neutral conditioner twice a year.

settings.title: Bring it back
settings.text: Send it to us for a clean, a stitch and a polish.

settings.heading: Looking after your leather
settings.text: A little care once or twice a year is all it needs.
